family.description: This is a family of short uncharacterised proteins predominantly found in bacteria. This model matches four of the twelve transmembrane helices of cytochrome c and quinol oxidase subunit I ([pfam:PF00115]) and contains the HxH motif conserved in both. A DALI search suggests that this family may be related to Cox1, however, there is no evidence for the involvement of this family in any Cox1-like assembly. AlphaFold prediction suggests that these proteins contain four transmembrane alpha helices which can for a homotrimeric complex.
family.name: Protein of unknown function (DUF2871)
